req.title: PUT rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-012 requires that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} returns HTTP 404 when the squad_number does not exist. The endpoint uses squad_number as the natural key. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case confirming an existing squad_number returns non-404 (proving the 404 path is conditional, not universal); (2) a negative/error-path case confirming a clearly non-existent squad_number returns exactly 404; (3) boundary cases at the edges of the known data set (squad_number 0, 27 = one beyond the last seeded row, and 26 = last seeded row). The PUT body must have squad_number matching the path parameter to avoid the 400 branch. All assertions use exact status codes to catch comparison-operator mutations (== vs !=, 404 vs 400 vs 200).

tests.name: test_put_existing_player_does_not_return_404
preconditions: Request body squad_number matches path parameter
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid body where squad_number=10
expected: HTTP response status code is NOT 404
HTTP response status code is 204 (no content on success path)
trace: R-PLAYER-012: 404 must only fire for unknown players; known player must not trigger it
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_player_does_not_return_404():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_squad_number_mismatch_returns_400_not_404
preconditions: Request body squad_number does NOT match path parameter (body=99, path=1)
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 400 (not 404, not 204)
trace: R-PLAYER-012: decision table — mismatch between path and body squad_number triggers 400 BEFORE the 404 check; confirms 404 is not returned for this distinct error condition
